description: This file defines the FirstMoment class, which computes the first statistical moment (arithmetic mean) for a dataset, using recursive updating to improve numerical stability. It extends an abstract class for univariate statistics and includes methods for incrementing data, copying, and clearing the state.

classes.name: FirstMoment
classes.description: A class that calculates the first statistical moment (mean) of a dataset using recursive updating for numerical stability.
